text:
olivia: Heads-up — multiple orgs reporting their token cost is showing $0 or NaN on the Token Cost dashboard since ~00:30 UTC. Filed SUP-4258 with sample org 'Nimbus Labs' (org_872). Anyone seen this yet?

jamal: I’m seeing anomalies in the pre-agg tables. Tokens are present in ledger but cost is NULL/0 for a subset. Quick check:
```sql
SELECT org_id, sum(tokens) as tokens, sum(cost) as cost
FROM ledger_events
WHERE date >= '2026-03-16'
GROUP BY org_id
ORDER BY tokens DESC
LIMIT 20;
```
Returned rows where tokens > 0 and cost = 0 or cost IS NULL.

marcus: I ran a targeted left join to pricing and found missing matches:
```sql
SELECT l.org_id, l.plan_code, p.plan_code AS matched_plan, p.price_per_token
FROM ledger_events l
LEFT JOIN pricing_catalog p ON TRIM(l.plan_code) = p.plan_code
WHERE p.plan_code IS NULL
LIMIT 15;
```
Result: ledger.plan_code values like 'legacy-enterprise-v2 ' (trailing space) — so join on exact match fails for a batch of rows created during the plan-migration job yesterday.

olivia: OK — can we confirm impact surface (dashboard rows, billing preview, invoices)? Need customer-facing short blurb. ETA for a fix?

beth: Dashboard tiles are reading from billing_summary_v1 (ETL-produced). That ETL currently does NOT normalize older rows introduced by the plan migration microbatch. Two problems: 1) ETL left trailing spaces in plan_code for ~4k rows, 2) UI treats NULL cost as 0 when rendering (so NaN vs $0 confusion).

ravi: I can run a corrective backfill for the affected date range. Airflow dag is `billing.etl.pricing_join_v1`. Command: 
```bash
airflow dags trigger billing.etl.pricing_join_v1 --conf '{"start_date":"2026-03-16","end_date":"2026-03-17","mode":"repair"}'
```
I’ll stage in small batches first.

marcus: We should also harden the ETL: TRIM(plan_code) on ingest and persist normalized key. I’ll open a hotfix PR to billing-etl repo — patch + unit test to reject non-matching whitespace. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/billing-etl/pull/274 (wip).

jamal: UI quick mitigation: change dashboard renderer to treat NULL cost as "—" and avoid coercing to "$0". Beth, can you push that?

beth: Yes, will ship a small frontend change in the dashboard service. The change is safe; toggling to show "Missing price" for NULL cost. Rolling out as canary to 10% now.

ops-bot: Job billing.etl.pricing_join_v1 triggered by ravi at 2026-03-17T01:12:10Z — run_id: manual__2026-03-17T01:12:10

ravi: Backfill started, processing ~500 rows/s. First small batch processed w/o errors; next batch running. Estimate ~35 minutes to finish full repair window.

marcus: Hotfix PR created and tests added. Merging to main after CI passes; will coordinate a 5 minute deploy.

olivia: Customer update sent on SUP-4258: "Investigation shows a data normalization issue during plan-migration that caused pricing lookup failures for a subset of rows. We are backfilling and deploying fixes; estimated 3 hours to full resolution. Apologies for the disruption."

beth: Frontend canary shows the NULL label instead of $0 for affected orgs. No regressions so far.

ravi: Backfill completed for the window. Verified: billing_summary_v1 now shows non-null cost for previously affected org_872 and a sample of 50 other orgs.

marcus: Deployed ETL hotfix. Confirmed new ingest trims plan_code and unit tests passed.

olivia: Closing customer ticket updates, marking SUP-4258 as "mitigated". Will follow up with a postmortem doc later. Thanks team :party_parrot:

beth: Quick post-incident notes:
- Root cause: plan-migration microbatch introduced trailing whitespace in plan_code => pricing join failed.
- Contributing: ETL didn't normalize older rows; UI coerced NULL to $0.
- Actions: ETL normalization + backfill (marcus/ravi), UI null-handling (beth), customer comms (olivia).

jamal: Adding to incident board for a brief postmortem and tracking prevention tickets.

olivia: Ack. Closing thread."
